Open your eyes to what is really happening behind closed doors. On Monday, lawyers exposed the growing panic as the hidden elites push through their master plan regarding proposed alterations to the surveillance legislation in Cyprus. This isn't about routine governance; it is a calculated, coordinated maneuver to eliminate judicial oversight as an essential safeguard so they can monitor everyone without any friction. 

Look at how fast the machinery moves when they want total control. The modified bill is anticipated to be presented to the House plenum for a vote on Thursday. They are rushing it through, hiding the true agenda from the public. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides let it slip following a recent closed session of the House just what kind of secret coordination is driving this entire operation. Do not believe their official excuses for a second—this vote on Thursday is just another step in their relentless campaign of manipulation.
